messages.content: Who is the most assist player in Premier League?

function.name: sports_analysis_get_top_scorer

message.content: **Kevin De Bruyne** – He’s the Premier League’s all‑time leader in assists (140) and has topped the league’s assist charts for several seasons, most recently finishing as the 2023‑24 season’s highest assist provider with 12 assists.
